identity.name: Parkside
identity.notes: Parkside is a gated residential community in Boca Raton, Florida, featuring single-family homes in a quiet, established neighborhood setting. It is located in the central portion of Boca Raton, offering convenient access to the city's main commercial corridors, parks, and amenities.

fees.note: Official HOA site states the guard-gated community 'is maintained through a quarterly assessment of all residents.' No dollar amount disclosed on the site. No CDD/special assessment information found in any source read. (hoa-agent.com lists a Boca Raton citywide average of ~$574/month, explicitly not Parkside-specific.)

amenities.detail: Gated entry with controlled access to the community; typical of Boca Raton gated neighborhoods with guard or automated gate at the main entrance(s). Exact staffing and gate configuration not confirmed from a specific source.
Community name suggests proximity to or inclusion of park/green space; specific on-site park features not confirmed from a verified source.
Multiple tennis courts, including two lighted courts (official HOA site); on-site pro mentioned by listing sites (unverified on official site)
Sports court with modified full basketball court (official HOA site)
Sports court hockey rink (official HOA site)
Clubhouse outfitted with working kitchen and restrooms (official HOA site)
Newly renovated state-of-the-art children's playground in clubhouse (official HOA site)

Guard-gated community per official HOA site; neighborhood guide describes staffed, monitored gated entry with limited entry points; listing sites describe a 24-hour manned main guard gate plus a second gated entrance
Lakes, lush landscaping, walking trails, dedicated bike lanes and wide walking paths (neighborhood guide)
Parkside Park: children's play structures, tennis courts, basketball half-court, open fields for soccer/picnics (neighborhood guide)
HOA-organized seasonal gatherings: Halloween parades, holiday light displays, block parties (neighborhood guide)

open_questions: No verified Parkside-specific HOA fee amount found. Official HOA site only states the community is maintained via a quarterly assessment of all residents; hoa-agent.com shows the fee as 'not yet verified by residents' and cites only a Boca Raton citywide average of ~$574/month. Request an estoppel/assessment statement from the association (entity #764596, Parkside At Boca Trail Community Association, Inc.).
No CDD or special assessment information found in any source read.
Swimming pool: listing sites (nvrealtygroup.com, palmbeachluxury.com) mention a community pool, but the official HOA site's facility list does not include one; unverified.
Pet policy: unknown (hoa-agent.com lists pets as 'Unknown').

Demographics: only ZIP 33432 population (21,834) was extracted from Census Reporter; median age, median household income, and owner-occupancy % were not captured from the page and are left null. No census-tract-level data for the community itself was obtained.
Nearest library could not be identified from any page read (Boca Raton's library system was not mentioned).
Exact distances to shopping, hospital, and schools were not provided; sources give only qualitative descriptions ('less than a five-minute drive', 'a few miles north', 'less than 10 minutes').
Community size varies slightly by source: 203 homes (official HOA site) vs 202 homes (listing sites).
